description: Officials and their functions in Croatian political parties from 1990 to 2015, including party parliamentary mandates in the Hrvatski sabor: person (surname, given name), function, party and period of office. Sources: Registar političkih stranaka (Ministry of Administration), Hrvatski sabor and the parties. Compiled 2015-08-11. Via codeforcroatia/open-data.
